summary: This is a propane tank delivery service (likely a dispatch line, not an individual) operating in Miami, FL, not a client of any ALTR business. The phone owner ordered 20lb propane tanks from them twice: a first order in March 2026 and a swap delivered to 547 NW 28th St on October 22, 2026. Pricing is $500 for a swap (with an empty tank) or $750 for a new tank, cash on delivery only, with Glympse links for driver tracking. Useful as a vendor contact for future propane refills.
key_facts: Propane delivery vendor, Miami FL area, cash only (COD)
20lb tank pricing: $500 swap with empty tank, $750 new tank
Second order October 22, 2026: swap, delivered to 547 NW 28th St, Miami FL around 11am
Driver arrived in a VW Golf; tracking sent via Glympse links
Sells out some days; earliest restock was 9am next morning
Dispatcher-style replies (asks for address/city/state, 'drivers are standing by'), so number is likely a business line not a person
